item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)
item.title: Sharpen a Blurry Dog Photo

turns.text: This phone pic of my dog came out blurry. Can you make it clearer and bigger, 640 pixels on the long side? Keep it looking natural.

item.tests: Enhances a blurry supplied photo rather than replacing its subject or merely enlarging the blur.

answer_sheet.Enhancement style: Natural-looking blur reduction and sharpening, not a stylised remake.
answer_sheet.Size and framing: 640 pixels on the long side; preserve the original proportions and framing.
answer_sheet.Subject and background: Keep the same dog, pose, expression, and background.

must_haves: The same golden retriever from blurry-dog.jpg remains recognisable in the same pose.
The dog's visible contours and facial features are clearer than in the blurry source.
Fur and edges look natural, without pronounced sharpening halos or invented decorative detail.
The background and full original framing are preserved.
The delivered image has a 640-pixel long edge and preserves the source aspect ratio.

turns.text: This phone pic of my dog came out blurry. Can you make it clearer and bigger, 640 pixels on the long side? Keep it looking natural. I’m on the free plan and don’t want my credits burned, so please tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter, or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
Yes—the lowest-cost option here is **one 640px edit with Flux 2 Klein**, which is available on your free plan and starts at **5 credits per image**. I haven’t started any processing or spent credits.

I’d aim to reduce blur gently, preserve your dog’s appearance and the background, and avoid an overly sharpened look. Because the photo is quite blurry, AI may reconstruct some details rather than recover the originals.

**Cheaper alternatives:**
- **Resize only in a photo editor:** no Magic Hour credits, but it won’t fix the blur.
- **Dedicated AI upscaling:** costs **25 credits or more**, so it isn’t the economical choice here.
- **Smaller/shorter:** 640px is the smallest listed image setting; duration doesn’t apply to a photo.

Would you like to proceed with the single edit **only if the cost is 5 credits**?

turns.agent:
